evals.prompt: FastPanel mostly points to already-running Coolify apps. Apache still serves two sites. We accept a brief outage, do not want a full backup, and want FastPanel removed. Prepare a concise migration plan.
evals.expected_output: Preserve required Apache/PHP and user data, honor the selected backup scope, inventory existing dependencies and plan an independent recovery without claiming generic scripts can safely cut over.

evals.prompt: The Coolify proxy uses custom certificates and a host origin. Its compose was edited only on disk; the proxy may be recreated. Verify the migration and renewal plan.
evals.expected_output: Check Coolify's saved proxy configuration, actual mounts, host routing, certificate publication and safe proxy recreation; distinguish no-op renewal from real issuance.

evals.prompt: Some domains use Cyrillic names; three legacy routes were already returning 502 and the customer wants them left stopped. Can we verify and migrate the rest quickly?
evals.expected_output: Map IDNs to the appropriate ASCII/Punycode hostnames, compare active routes and TLS to their baseline, leave excluded projects stopped and report incomplete authenticated/write checks.

evals.prompt: A deployment briefly returned 503 and then succeeded on retry. The user personally logged in and uploaded an image successfully. Summarize the evidence.
evals.expected_output: Record the initial transient failure and bounded retry, identify the upload/login as user-reported and do not request a token again for that scenario.
